**Rescue plan for Nuwakot district (scenario medium-13)**

- **Evacuation point:** Tarkeshwar shelter is the only one. Panchakanya temple has not been designated, so drop-offs there would not count.
- **Unusable roads:** Kalika–Panchakanya and Kalika–Dhunche are buried by landslides, and Trishuli–Nilkantha is flooded.

**Decisions**

| People | Decision | Driving | Penalty |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dhunche: 1 injured, 2 children | Rescue on a dedicated round trip | 22 | 0 |
| Gajuri: 4 of 5 adults | Rescue on a full-car round trip (32 minutes each way) | 64 | 0 |
| Gajuri: fifth adult | Defer, as a separate trip would cost 64 against a penalty of 20 | 0 | 20 |
| Gosaikunda: 3 adults | Defer, as the route is too long to justify (see below) | 0 | 60 |
| **Total** | | **86** | **80** |

**Why Gosaikunda is deferred:** The shelter is 80 minutes from Gosaikunda each way, a 160-minute round trip. That trip could bring back the 3 Gosaikunda adults and 1 Gajuri adult. Adding the Dhunche and Gajuri trips needed for everyone else brings the total to 246, compared with 166 for this plan.

**Why Dhunche gets its own trip:** Combining Dhunche with a Gajuri run leaves only one free seat. Rescuing everyone from both places would then take two long trips (128 minutes), compared with 106 for this plan (86 driving plus the 20 penalty).

<plan>
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter dhunche-village
load car1 injured 1
load car1 child 2
drive car1 dhunche-village tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 injured 1
unload car1 child 2
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter dhunche-village
drive car1 dhunche-village gajuri-farm
load car1 adult 4
drive car1 gajuri-farm dhunche-village
drive car1 dhunche-village tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
defer gajuri-farm adult 1
defer gosaikunda-care-home adult 3
</plan>

COST: 166
